components.prompt: Create a single small ornamental race emblem for a Kalistar fantasy playing card, NOT a character illustration, NOT a card. Subject: OKAMI, harmonious wolf-human people. A noble mature wolf's HEAD AND SHORT NECK in three-quarter view looking left, long natural wolf muzzle, alert upright ears, layered tufts, intelligent calm almond eye. Cast and hand-chased weathered SILVER with discreet warm COPPER bevels and dark graphite engraved recesses, tiny muted forest-green eye. Painted metal bas-relief like a tiny handcrafted heraldic brooch, angular tactile brushwork, crisp coherent silhouette legible at 70 pixels. No snarling monster, no cartoon, no human face, no humanoid torso. Only one head emblem, centered fully visible with generous transparent margin. NO circular border, NO medallion ring, NO shield, no text, no scenery, no ground shadow, no glow. Genuine transparent alpha outside the emblem. Squarish composition. The detail is subordinate to a strong wolf silhouette. This will sit inside an existing copper card medallion; do not draw that medallion.

Adapt this approved Grivka flag into a flat FRONT-FACING TEXTILE DESIGN suitable for an extremely narrow vertical pennant on a playing card. Keep EXACTLY its visual identity: black and very dark forest green cloth, large SILVER WOLF HEAD emblem, the small silver mountain mark beneath it, sober silver edge trim. Retain the wolf's distinctive pointed ear and angular cheek shapes from this reference. Remove the pole, mounting loops, floating side tails, background and three-dimensional presentation. Output a simple long vertical rectangular textile panel with no spear point bottom (the existing native card's silhouette will cut it later); a narrow aspect ratio approximately 1:2.25, edge-to-edge cloth on the entire canvas. The silver wolf head occupies the upper central half, small mountain below, lower part plain deep forest green. It must remain readable when reduced to 98 by 223 pixels. No letters, no text, no extra symbol, no new faction, no luminous neon, no ornate additions. Painted worn fabric and simple metallic thread, not a photograph. This is an exact faction symbol adaptation, not a new banner design.
